posts.description: Show me there were big waves without showing me any waves… This massive piece of driftwood, which has stayed in one spot on the sand for two years, was perched up on the dune today. 😮
The latest dispatch for the Pacific Wave Appreciation Society, from your intrepid wave watcher and driftwood tracker. 🌊 Nedonna Beach

For the Pacific Wave Appreciation Society. It was wild this morning at high tide. 7 ft. swells. A little too exciting. I cut my walk short in an abundance of caution. (Bonus dog content in the video.)
